name: Father Gregory
source:
Leader of the radical religious group, Dominion. His group reveres artificial intelligence as a god, Sofia, and teaches that the current state of reality is but an illusion.

[spoiler]He pilots the Simulacrum "Baptizein".[/spoiler]
